item.title: 9 Things to Do in Tskaltubo, Georgia: Soviet Ruins, Radon Baths and a Cave
item.description: Tskaltubo has about 20 Soviet sanatoriums, most empty since the 1990s, and radon baths that still work. A private cabin at Stalin's Bathhouse No. 6 is 25 GEL, and minibus No. 30 from Kutaisi is 2 GEL. All 9 with prices and routes in the guide. Save this pin for your trip.
